interpretation.state_model: bounded pure-state statevector; at most 4 qubits
interpretation.measurement: computational-basis projective measurement with explicit collapse; simulate_dynamic_circuit rejects nondeterministic outcomes
interpretation.classical_state: explicit named classical bits populated by measurement
interpretation.feedforward: single-bit predicates of the form register == 1; optional explicit Pauli X/Z correction table
interpretation.reset: unsupported as an operational semantic action
interpretation.branch_completeness: not provided by simulate_dynamic_circuit; nondeterministic branch enumeration is outside this profile

notes: Executable bounded operational profile for deterministic-branch dynamic fragments. It is not a full OpenQASM dynamic-circuit semantics, density-operator/channel semantics, hardware semantics, or arbitrary-input teleportation proof.
